scene.ofreeRecent: a starship data archive — kneeling on the ground; a retro-futurist home of rounded chrome appliances and soft panels — seated on a chair; a training gym with a heavy bag — aims a bright plastic water gun playfully toward the camera; A bright open-air wave pool at noon — She hoists a bright float onto a rack after practice; A cool white-lit indoor transit arcade with a bank of capsule dispensers near a panoramic window — She catches the little translucent capsule she just won and lifts it to see the miniature figure inside; a neon-lit game arcade — seated on a chair; her crew cabin aboard a starship — tilts a cup; a hanfu photo studio with costume racks — perched on a ledge or edge; an indoor lap pool with lane ropes — chest-deep in the water; a walled garden with a lotus pond — rests a red oil-paper umbrella open on her shoulder; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — lying on her left side; the long stone stairway of Baidicheng above the Yangtze gorge — standing with one foot up on a step; a futuristic spa of white curves and soft light — standing
